doc.name: SportPoint
doc.instructions:
SportPoint (sportpoint.bg) is a Bulgarian marketplace for sports coaches, clubs and venues (places).
The data is in Bulgarian: sport names, city names, levels and descriptions. Pass Bulgarian values to the filters; list_sports_and_cities lists the valid sports and cities.
Prices are in EUR. Session dates and times are the Europe/Sofia wall clock.
Booking happens on sportpoint.bg, not through this server. Always give the user the `url` of each coach, club, place or session you mention, so they can open it and book there.

tools.name: search_coaches
tools.title: Search Coaches
tools.description: Search the sports coaches listed on SportPoint (Bulgaria). Filter by sport, city, age group or free text (coach name or sport). Returns ten coaches per page, each with a public profile url. Sport and city values are in Bulgarian; call list_sports_and_cities for the valid values.

sport.description: Sport name in Bulgarian (e.g. "Плуване") or its slug (e.g. "pluvane").

search.description: Free text matched against coach names and sport names.

tools.name: get_coach
tools.title: Get Coach
tools.description: Get the public profile of one SportPoint coach by slug (from search_coaches): sports, age groups, places and clubs where they train, bio, and up to ten upcoming sessions with price in EUR and spots left. Includes the profile url where the user can book.

slug.description: The coach slug, as returned by search_coaches.

tools.name: search_clubs_and_places
tools.title: Search Clubs And Places
tools.description: Search the sports clubs and the places (gyms, pools, halls, venues) published on SportPoint (Bulgaria) by name and city. type selects clubs, places or both. Each result has a public url; use get_club or get_place with its slug for details and the weekly schedule.

search.description: Words from the club or place name.

type.description: What to search: clubs, places, or both.

tools.name: get_club
tools.title: Get Club
tools.description: Get one SportPoint club by slug (from search_clubs_and_places): description, places, coaches, and one Monday-to-Sunday week of its sessions with price in EUR and spots left. Pass week as any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the wanted week; the default is the current week.

slug.description: The club slug, as returned by search_clubs_and_places.

week.description: Any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the week to show. Defaults to the current week.

tools.name: get_place
tools.title: Get Place
tools.description: Get one SportPoint place (gym, pool, hall, venue) by slug (from search_clubs_and_places): address, description, and one Monday-to-Sunday week of the sessions held there with price in EUR and spots left. Pass week as any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the wanted week; the default is the current week.

slug.description: The place slug, as returned by search_clubs_and_places.

week.description: Any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the week to show. Defaults to the current week.

tools.name: find_sessions
tools.title: Find Sessions
tools.description: Find upcoming training sessions on SportPoint (Bulgaria). Filter by sport, city, date or day, time of day, age group, level and maximum price in EUR. Sessions open for online booking come first. Each session has its date and times on the Europe/Sofia wall clock, price in EUR, spots left (null = no limit), whether online booking is open, and a url where the user books it. Twenty per page.

sport.description: Sport name in Bulgarian (e.g. "Плуване") or its slug (e.g. "pluvane").

date.description: One calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Sofia). Wins over day.

day.description: A relative day on the Europe/Sofia clock; this_week runs to Sunday.

time.description: Start time band, Europe/Sofia wall clock.

level.description: Level name as the club or coach wrote it, in Bulgarian (e.g. "Начинаещи").

price_max.description: Maximum price per session in EUR.

tools.name: list_sports_and_cities
tools.title: List Sports And Cities
tools.description: List the sports and the cities that have coaches on SportPoint (Bulgaria). Names are in Bulgarian. Use these values for the sport and city filters of search_coaches and find_sessions.
